title: Volume Adjustment Schedule on the Contracted Price of a Refined Fuels Account
content:
An account under Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts that has taken a great deal of fuel over the year, and has been served often enough to show it, has an adjustment taken off its contracted price. Both the gallons and the stops must answer.

**Where the gallons taken on the account over the twelve months ending on the handling date reach 4000 gallons and 4 or more stops were billed on it in that window**, the volume adjustment is 0.04 USD per gallon.

**Where those gallons reach 2000 gallons and fall under 4000 gallons and 4 or more stops were billed in that window**, the volume adjustment is 0.02 USD per gallon.

**In every other case** no volume adjustment is taken off the contracted price.

| Gallons taken in the twelve months ending on the handling date | Stops billed in that window | Volume adjustment |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 4000 or more | 4 or more | 0.04 USD per gallon |
| 2000 or more, and fewer than 4000 | 4 or more | 0.02 USD per gallon |
| 4000 or more | Fewer than 4 | Nothing |
| 2000 or more, and fewer than 4000 | Fewer than 4 | Nothing |
| Fewer than 2000 | Either way | Nothing |

Both thresholds are met at the figure exactly: 4000.0 gallons meets the first band and 2000.0 gallons the second; 4 stops meets the stop test.

*Hypothetical.* An account with 4200.0 gallons taken and 5 stops billed in the window has 0.04 USD per gallon taken off. The same account with only 3 stops billed has nothing taken off. An account with 2500.0 gallons taken and 4 stops billed has 0.02 USD per gallon taken off. An account with 1900.0 gallons taken has nothing taken off however many stops were billed.
